## Printed
heading: A GEORGE WASHINGTON CROSS-WORD PUZZLE.
intro: Today being the anniversary of George Washington's birthday, what could be more appropriate to the occasio: than a real, patriotic Georga Washington puzzle. So here is one, the tenth in FUN'S series of cross-word puzzles
instructions: Fill in the small squares in the diamond with words corresponding to the clews and definitions given herewith, allowing one letter of the word to each square.
intro: On another page you will find the solution to last week's cross-word puzzle showing just how the letters are placed to form words reading up and down and across.
solution caption: Herewith is shown the solution to the George Washington cross-word puzzle. An easier and less complicated cross-word puzzle is given today. See if you can solve it. The answers to today's puzzles will be given in next week's FUN.
